title: Empowering Older Adults in Digital Technology Use with Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the communication characteristics of older adults (e.g., verbosity, under-specification, incompleteness) in real-world technology support queries and evaluating how foundation models perform on these original queries versus AI-paraphrased versions. The evaluation includes both automated NLP metrics (BLEU, ROUGE-L, BERTScore) and human evaluations assessing comprehension, confidence, and ease of understanding to demonstrate algorithmic ageism in systems optimized for younger, digitally fluent users.
